product.name: T150 Rechargeable Electric Air Duster
product.description: A rechargeable handheld air duster intended for keyboards, computers, cars, and other dust-clearing tasks.

specifications.Accessories: Four nozzles and two brush heads

script_facts: This is a rechargeable handheld air duster intended for clearing dust from keyboards, computers, and desks.
The product includes four nozzles and two brush heads for different dust-clearing tasks.
It provides a reusable air source instead of disposable canned air.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim exact cleaning speed, battery runtime, air pressure, instant results, or independently tested performance.
Do not imply the product is safe for every surface or device.
editorial_direction: Lead with dust trapped around keyboard keys and desk equipment.
Focus on the reusable handheld format, USB-C charging, and interchangeable nozzles.
Describe only visible dust-clearing use cases shown in the merchant demonstration.
Do not name the brand, model, marketplace, price, rating, or review count in narration.
Close on a concrete desk-cleaning use case without a viewer question or sales prompt.

media_candidates.label: Amazon merchant demonstration video
usage_notes: Observed through a normal Playwright browser session without login, CAPTCHA, DRM, or anti-bot bypass.
The 28-second merchant demonstration was selected; customer-review videos were excluded.
Approved only for a watermarked internal editor workflow test.
This asset and every derivative remain non-publishable while reuse rights are unverified.
